    tr_finite = np.isfinite(train['coupon_features_raw'])

        residual = train['instant_rate_obs'] - train_rate

    strata = np.r_[train['stratum'], test['stratum']]
    for i in rows:
        missing = ~te_finite[i]

        else:

        correction[i] = variance / (variance + noise**2) * innovation
    return correction
